verdict.rationale: User reviewed spec.md and approved; B.8 resolved as Remove per prior decision.
User reviewed plan.md (6 tasks, all test-first) and approved.

8 blocking findings (4 critical, 4 major) from full-profile review: security stacktrace leak (CR-003), OTEL trace loss from stream.close() ordering (CR-005), missing SupervisorCoordinator.reset() on MCP-auth exit (CR-002), truncation check gap for generate_structured_response (CR-006), plus 4 minor. User approved sending to review-fix.

Check-round re-verified all 8 prior blocking findings (CR-001..CR-008) against current source at commit 7fa7da5c6, not just the fix-agents self-report: success=True now set on the happy path, MCP-auth exception path now resets SupervisorCoordinator, stacktrace redaction gated on HIDE_AGENT_STREAMING_EXCEPTIONS, exception now recorded on span before stream.close(), and truncation check now scans every updates-node key with new tests for supervisor and sub-agent keys plus tool_errors mapping. No new blocking finding introduced by the fix-up. Residual nuance: CR-006 generate_structured_response half was structurally unreachable (that LangGraph node state update carries no messages key), not a defect in the fix; user confirmed this reading.
